HOME SCIENCE — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #7
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: HOME SCIENCE
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Paper burning to ash
   B. Iron rusting
   C. Milk souring
   D. Ice melting to water

2. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)

   B. Removing all vegetation
   C. Overgrazing continuously
   D. Burning crop residue every week

   A. 50 °C
   B. 0 °C
   C. 37 °C
   D. 100 °C

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Laundering of Fabrics? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Laundering of Fabrics.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Laundering of Fabrics.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Laundering of Fabrics.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Laundering of Fabrics.

   C. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
